name: image_qwen_image_2_1_t2i
description: Qwen-Image 2.1 text-to-image, with native output up to 2K (2048x2048). Pipeline mirrors ComfyUI's official image_qwen_image_2_1_t2i template: int8-convrot diffusion model, Qwen3-VL 8B text encoder (type qwen_image) via TextEncodeQwenImage21 with no reference images, Qwen-Image 2.1 VAE, 25 euler/simple steps at cfg 1, output sized by a ResolutionSelector (aspect_ratio picks the shape, resolution the megapixel budget, snapped to multiples of 32). One deviation: it loads the bf16 text encoder rather than the official int8 one, so it shares all three model files with the image_qwen_image_2_1_edit_* templates — no extra download if those are installed. For a transparent PNG, wrap the prompt as: 'This is an RGBA format image with transparency. <description>. The image has an alpha channel and a transparent background.' ~25.5 GB of model downloads; run check_requirements / download_models first. Weights are under the Qwen research license.

prompt.description: Text prompt describing the image to generate. Long, detailed natural-language prompts work well.

negative_prompt.description: Negative prompt. Has no effect at the default cfg 1; leave empty.

resolution.description: Output size, as the megapixel budget the ResolutionSelector spends on the chosen aspect ratio: '1mp' = 1024x1024 square (default), '2mp' = ~1440x1440, '4mp' = 2048x2048, the model's native 2K. Non-square ratios keep the same pixel budget. Time and VRAM scale with it.

steps.description: Sampler steps (default 25, as in the official template). Qwen's reference pipeline uses 40-50 with euler; raise it for fine detail at the cost of time.

seed.description: Sampler seed, for reproducing an earlier generation. Omit it and a fresh random seed is used on every submission.
